logo.name: Volve Forward Mark
logo.description: A bold V paired with a narrower forward continuation stroke.

primaryV.leftTop: straight horizontal cap with crisp corners
primaryV.rightTop: rounded inner transition into a horizontal cap and crisp outer point

continuationStroke.weight: approximately 40 percent of the primary V stroke weight
continuationStroke.top: rounded inner transition into a horizontal cap and crisp outer point

construction.negativeSpace: The two elements remain separate at every size.

usage.minimumClearSpace: One continuation-stroke width on every side.
usage.favicon: Use the appIcon asset without an additional enclosure.

restrictions: Do not join the V and continuation stroke.
Do not close the negative-space channel.
Do not round the upper-left terminal of the V.
Do not replace the crisp terminal points with semicircular caps.
Do not add gradients, shadows, outlines or effects.
Do not stretch, skew or rotate the symbol.
